test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pole E is to the east of pole R. Pole G is to the west of pole R and north of pole A. Pole T is to the south of pole A. What is the position of pole R with respect to pole A?
solution:
Diagrams are drawn according to the given statement as follows:

 
• Pole E is to the east of pole R.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9171b0f5330684cec4efa4a3bab3d47a426bedc644af1c8fc38fc64b9b0cad9a.png] 

 
• Pole G is to the west of pole R and north of pole A.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ad522c8ca37217982222506f9098093d956e36611bb949bab2eefd9b9837728.png] 

 
• Pole T is to the south of pole A.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c86aabd1dabb652dff400c268efd6bf205d8739d55efda6547e46cf9a7034a83.png] 

 
• Position of R with respect to A is:

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a885e6d702b8f1734b6c8fed62b59efb0f68ab14eb67cb3d6ce6f51fbb8fdfd4.png] 

Thus, Pole R is in **north-east direction **with respect to Pole A.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option (3).**
